name: Dropdown
summary: A trigger button that reveals a floating overlay of actions — with leading icons, dividers, disabled rows and a red danger action.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-dropdown> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. A trigger button reveals a floating overlay from the `items` list. The overlay is a Menu of the DS V3 item family, not a flat list: rows carry leading icons, a divider rules them off, an item can be disabled or a red danger action, and a group title splits sections. An item that carries `children:[…]` is a submenu-parent: hovering it (or ArrowRight / Enter) opens a SECOND floating panel to the side — a flyout, positioned adjacent to the parent row, with edge-collision handling (it flips to the other side when there's no room); ArrowLeft / Escape closes the flyout back to the parent. `placement` positions the overlay (bottomLeft default · bottomRight · topLeft · topRight) and `trigger` is click (default) or hover. Open/close animates via the shared motion tokens on a PERSISTENT panel (a class toggles — the subtree is never rebuilt on open), the caret rotates, every flyout fades/scales in on its own persistent node, and it closes on outside-click or Escape (focus returns to the trigger). Every glyph — the trigger caret, the submenu caret, each leading icon — is the DS icon by name via <aha-icon>. Emits a composed `select`.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for `select`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

whenToUse.when: a set of actions or options should sit behind a trigger to save space
the same list belongs inline, always visible — not behind a trigger
the control picks a single value for a form field, not fires an action

opinion.note: A dropdown holds actions or navigation, not form values — use Select for a field. Keep the item list short; the panel closes on outside-click and Escape. Give each action a leading icon, rule off a destructive action with a divider and mark it danger. Reach for a submenu-parent (children[]) only when a group of related actions would otherwise crowd the top level — one level of flyout is plenty; deeper nesting is a menu smell. The overlay reuses the shared Menu item vocabulary rather than reinventing the row styling.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Dropdown-Menu + Components/Dropdown/Menu-Item + Dropdown/Menu-Item-Group component sets: the overlay is a Menu of items carrying leading icons, dividers, group titles, disabled + danger rows — the same item family as Menu — plus submenu-parents whose children[] open an adjacent flyout (the DS V3 Menu-Item nested/expandable variant, here as a floating flyout with a trailing system-caret-right and aria-haspopup). Reference contract measured keys (dropdown|menu radius 8, dropdown|item height 40 with hover/focus states) plus the token layer: white trigger, border #E3E3E3, border-hover, bg-elevated panel, color-error danger, text-tertiary group title, radius-default 8; the flyout reuses the same elevated-panel + item tokens, and the open submenu-parent takes the brand-tinted bg-accent / color-primary highlight. Placement (bottomLeft/bottomRight/topLeft/topRight) + click/hover trigger from AntD Dropdown conventions; the flyout does edge-collision flip like AntD's rc-menu submenu. Motion bound to the shared motion tokens on persistent panels (root + each flyout); every glyph from the DS icon library.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe opens on load AND opens its submenu flyout, so the trigger, the panel's danger item, the submenu-parent (aria-haspopup + caret) and the flyout panel are all measurable together.
